items: The corridor followed the market. One-week repo averaged 4.68% in August, under the 5.50% floor. CBAR cut the floor to 5.00% on 23-Sep and held the rate at 6.50%.
NBFI coupons are sticky. The 2026 median is still 15% while the matched sovereign fell to about 7%, so the new-issue spread is about 8pp. Banks and SOEs pay about 3pp.
Prices are old. Only 29% of corporate lines traded in the last 30 days. Screen the age column before trusting a price.
12-month wall: AZN 433m, three-quarters from SOEs. The NBFI part (AZN 26m) is small but rolls in AZN 0.5-1m tranches.
